ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a ratio of approximately 65% low-intensity (dark/black) pixels to 35% high-intensity (white/gray) pixels, primarily concentrated on distal lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottled clusters are concentrated on the lateral-distal regions of both lobes, forming irregular geometric patches. The medial region surrounding the notch consists of a contiguous solid low-intensity dark pixel block.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 18% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels, creating a jagged linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitting the upper trailing edge transitioning to a sharp convex sweep at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular white pixel clusters visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface irregularities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular indentations and nicks along the trailing edge topography, particularly on the left lobe, indicating non-linear boundary degradation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric white pixel 'spray' pattern on the ventral surface of the right lobe, extending further toward the median than the corresponding pattern on the left lobe.
